mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market downturn that triggers corporate cost-cutting and reduced investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a collapsing housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 index points, manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 monthly additions signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) declines for two consecutive months, it indicates weakening household demand that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.01 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown in manufacturing and construction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02.
